_about: Policy of the dimensions a question does not set (plan 04, decision 5 as changed by the user on 2026-10-18;
unspecified_policy: representative = one representative table per dimension kind (default);
keep_all = every family table that gives the same cells is put in and marked (cap 3, the earlier decision 5).
Dimension kinds are read from catalog axis values and bracket qualifiers (select/cover.py dimension_kinds):
basis_axis_kinds maps each basis axis of condition_words.json to a kind; bracket words not on a basis axis are
frequency words, source words, or other; values of an axis whose name holds an agency word are compared too.
conventions: emptied (plan 10, user decision 2026-10-20: no default for a dimension the question did not set;
the survey view is a confirm kind and asked).
decision (plan 10 D step, select/differences.py): set_dimension_filter = keep only the contenders meeting a
dimension the question set; family_score_gap = score gap at which other-family alternatives go on (confirm,
d_resolved), null = always asked; ask_unset_kinds = mark kinds of unset dimensions that are asked;
undecided_ask (agent/question_route.py) = off | narrow (an undecided interpretation with a split piece not in
the catalog is asked, not decided) | wide (also with an unused catalog name).
